source_description: Kevin Hillstrom, MineThatData E-Mail Analytics And Data Mining Challenge, published 2008-03-20. Released publicly for analysis; the author asks that the source be credited. Raw data is not redistributed by this repository.

split.rule: sha256('hillstrom-v4.1:' + row_id), first 8 hex digits as a uniform draw

data_roles.development: model selection, tuning, all exploratory readouts
data_roles.confirmation: unopened; one primary contrast, after the protocol is frozen

scope_note: Randomised three-arm e-mail campaign with a two-week readout. The design is documented by the author but this repository has not verified assignment independently; treat the design probability as declared, not measured, until an assignment audit has been run.
